title: Turkish Token Tax: tokenizer efficiency TR vs EN
subtitle: How many more tokens Turkish needs than English, per tokenizer
description: Aggregate token counts for Turkish and English on the 1012-pair FLORES-200 devtest split, measured with pinned tokenizer revisions. The TR/EN ratio is the 'token tax'. Derived from FLORES-200 devtest (NLLB Team, 2022, https://github.com/facebookresearch/flores), licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0. Only aggregate token counts are included; no corpus text.
